messages:
jamie: Heads up — routine leak scan flagged a GCP service account JSON key embedded inside a CI artifact cache (ci/cache/monorepo/artifacts/build-857.tar).

olivia: Can you drop the scan excerpt and exact path? I want to know if it was committed or only cached.

jamie: ```
file: ci/cache/monorepo/artifacts/build-857.tar
match: service-account-key (JSON)
snippet: "private_key_id": "REDACTED-XXXX", "client_email": "redwood-build@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

matt: Ack. If that's a long-lived key we need to revoke now. Olivia, can you request immediate revoke + rotation?

laura: I already opened a ticket with cloud-ops: #INC-3921. Request to disable the key and list other keys for that SA. Putting steps in there.

sec-bot: ALERT: high severity secret exposure detected (alert_id: sec-2026-114). Scan rule: gcp-service-account-json.

oncall-bot: Paging @olivia, @matt: you are oncall for sec this window.

olivia: Thanks. Matt, can you run: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-build@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=...` once confirmed? Also rotate any consumers using the key.

matt: Running now. Found 2 keys, deleting the older one (KEY_ID=11a2...). Deleting: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete 11a2... --iam-account=redwood-build@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

jamie: Also important: the key was not in a git commit, it looks like the CI runner cached a service-account JSON created by a legacy build step that wrote creds to workspace and got archived. So we need to invalidate caches and scrub artifacts.

laura: Action list I'm tracking in the ticket: revoke key, rotate secrets in Secret Manager, invalidate all CI caches, re-run affected builds with new creds, run retroactive scan across artifact storage (gs://redwood-ci-artifacts/*).

olivia: For audit: run `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"redwood-build@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND timestamp>\"2025-11-01T00:00:00Z\"" --limit 1000` to see usage window. Share results in the ticket.

matt: Audit results: I see a handful of pushes from the CI runner between 2025-11-02 and 2025-11-05 — I'll attach in ticket. No external use logged.

jamie: Good. Next: modify CI image/build steps to never write raw SA JSON to disk. Replace with workload identity where possible, or mount short-lived tokens. Also stop archiving the workspace into artifact cache.

laura: I've added immediate mitigations: (1) CI guardrail to fail builds if `*private_key*` pattern appears in workspace; (2) invalidate caches created before 2025-11-06; (3) add artifact scanning job to nightly pipeline.

olivia: Long term: add a policy to our onboarding docs to require Workload Identity Federation for GCP and enforce least-privilege roles. Also require `git-secrets` pre-commit for all repos and a repo-level scanning rule in CI.

sec-bot: Detected similar risk in 3 other artifacts during retro scan: gs://redwood-ci-artifacts/build-*.tar (matches=service-account-json). Marked as medium, manual review required.

matt: I'll coordinate deletion of those artifacts and re-run builds. Also rotating any tokens that may have been embedded into downstream services.

jamie: Compliance note: This is PII/credential exposure — opening an internal incident report and notifying InfoSec. We should also log the revocation IDs and time for audit.

laura: Filing retro tasks: ticket SEC-ROTATE-2026, policy fixes PR #418, CI template update PR #419. Assigning to platform and devex.

olivia: Postmortem owners? Jamie + Matt + Laura. We'll draft a short incident report and include followups: RBAC audit, KMS key access review, and CI image hardening.

jamie: Quick checklist for now: 1) revoked key — done (matt). 2) invalidated caches — in progress (laura). 3) deleted artifacts flagged by retro scan — in progress (matt). 4) secret scanner rules tightened — planned (laura). 5) notify legal/compliance — laura to do.

matt: All immediate actions completed except artifact deletions — will finish in 30m and post confirmation.

laura: Notified Compliance via #compliance (DM sent). Will upload timeline and revocation IDs to the incident doc once artifact cleanup is confirmed.

olivia: Thanks team. Recommended followups for next week: run a full repo history scan, add a CI-level scrubber for archives, and schedule RBAC review for the `redwood-build` SA.

jamie: I'll draft the incident summary and causal analysis today and share for review. :white_check_mark:
